Headline findings

modality lift
U-Net SAR+Optical 100%-labels F1=0.849 vs SAR-only 0.618 (+0.231)
label efficiency
U-Net SAR+Optical reaches 93% of full performance at just 5% labels (17 chips)
cross region gap
Leave-one-out F1 range 0.54 (Pakistan) to 0.96 (Mekong) — domain gap quantified
AE temporal diff helps
AE pre+post stack F1=0.708 > AE pre-only conv 0.631 > AE pre-only MLP 0.602 — temporal differencing recovers +0.077 F1
AE still below optical
Best AE variant (pre+post stack) still 0.14 below U-Net+S2 — AE annual prior doesn't fully replace post-event optical observation
AUPRC steady climb
AUPRC: S1-only 0.71 -> AE+S1 MLP 0.79 -> AE conv 0.79 -> AE stack 0.80 -> U-Net+S2 0.90 — foundation prior helps ranking quality at every level
decision metrics
USA test set: 130/5467 buildings (2.4%) and 77.7/1174 km roads (6.6%) predicted affected by floods — Hu Nature 2026 paradigm
